why_all: GDACS gives a single cross-hazard, cross-country severity feed (not just US-only like FEMA) -- useful as a lightweight global disaster-shock indicator across APAC/LatAm/EMEA markets that FEMA/NIFC/HURDAT2 don't cover, complementing gap #11 outside the US.

GDACS is a genuinely global, near-real-time, free disaster feed (UN/EU backed) broader than EM-DAT's slower-updated historical archive; a lightweight client makes it feasible to build a live events-and-shocks flag feeding the nights/ADR nowcast for the current quarter, not just backtests.
